claim: Mooncake's KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture separates prefill and decoding clusters and uses underutilized CPU, DRAM, and SSD resources of the GPU cluster to implement a disaggregated KVCache pool.
stance_target: KV cache should be treated as a first-class, tiered, cluster-wide resource pool rather than confined per-GPU/per-pod
scope_conditions: Mooncake, production platform for Kimi (Moonshot AI)
quoted_support: It features a KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture that separates the prefill and decoding clusters. It also leverages the underutilized CPU, DRAM, and SSD resources of the GPU cluster to implement a disaggregated cache of KVCache.

claim: Mooncake's core scheduler balances maximizing overall effective throughput against per-request latency SLOs (TTFT and TBT), and includes a prediction-based early-rejection policy for overload scenarios.
stance_target: necessary properties of a KV-cache-aware global scheduler under SLO constraints and overload
quoted_support: The core of Mooncake is its KVCache-centric scheduler, which balances maximizing overall effective throughput while meeting latency-related Service Level Objectives (SLOs)... To mitigate these, we developed a prediction-based early rejection policy.

claim: Mooncake achieved up to a 525% increase in throughput over baseline in certain simulated long-context scenarios while adhering to SLOs, and enabled Kimi to handle 75% more requests under real production workloads.
stance_target: KV-cache-centric disaggregated scheduling produces large, measured throughput gains in production
scope_conditions: Mooncake, long-context simulated scenarios and real Kimi production workloads
quoted_support: Mooncake can achieve up to a 525% increase in throughput in certain simulated scenarios while adhering to SLOs. Under real workloads, Mooncake's innovative architecture enables Kimi to handle 75% more requests.
